title: When the Veil Breaks
author: Yara Fairweather
blurb: Wendell Dravenmoor, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
